assumptions: Upper-division GE requires 60 completed units (junior standing).

BS CS GE slots map to areas 1A, 1C, 3A, 3B, 6, American Institutions (history; CA government), UD-3, UD-4; inferred from the program page exemptions and the roadmap slot count. The U.S. Constitution part is assumed met by the history or government course (true for HIST 1460 and PSCI 2030).
Prerequisites outside the program (e.g. CSE 1250, MATH 1401) are entry-level placement assumptions.

Courses on no roadmap have Unknown offering (allowed with a warning). Summer offerings are never published: summer placements are allowed only when the student adds a summer term, and are flagged unconfirmed.
Units given as a range use the minimum; variable-unit courses are excluded from the elective pool.
